description: This file contains a specialized WebApplicationFactory for testing purposes, configuring a test environment with in-memory databases and environment settings, primarily used in functional testing of the 'Web' components of the eShopWeb application.

classes.name: TestApplication
classes.description: A custom WebApplicationFactory for integration testing, configured with a specific environment and in-memory databases for CatalogContext and AppIdentityDbContext.

methods.name: CreateHost
methods.description: Overrides the base method to set the environment and configure dependency injection for test purposes, replacing database services with in-memory implementations.
